prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset type: one explanatory architecture illustration for a Chinese robotics research article; labels inside the figure must be short English only. Primary request: accurately illustrate PEAR's robot-use interaction loop and its simulation-only reinforcement-learning update. White wide 16:9 canvas, thin rounded dark outlines, restrained pastel blue for observations, purple for model, orange for actions/training, green for execution, ample whitespace, crisp readable sans-serif labels. Main upper row left to right: blue box 'Images + robot state' with three tiny camera panels and a simple coordinate icon; purple box 'Reasoning model' with line 'Read task + history'; orange box 'JSON action' with line 'Deltas: cm, rad'; green box 'IK + controller'; green box 'Robot / simulator' with a clean tabletop arm icon. Draw one clear rightward arrow between each adjacent box. A return arrow below this row goes from 'Robot / simulator' back to 'Images + robot state', labeled 'Next observation'. Above the reasoning model add a small neutral box 'Robot description' with a downward arrow into the model. At the bottom, separated from the main observation-return arrow, draw a light orange band titled 'RL training: simulation only'. Inside the band a three-step sequence 'Simulated episodes' -> 'Success: 0 or 1' -> 'Model update'. A dashed orange arrow leaves 'Model update' and goes to the upper 'Reasoning model', labeled 'Update weights'. No gradient or weight-update arrows go to the IK/controller or real robot. Small note at bottom right 'Deployment: fixed weights'. Clearly separate the observation feedback loop from the training update path; keep lines uncrossed and do not route the training arrow through the camera box. No high-level pick/place skill box, no depth map, no action chunks, no direct joint-torque model output, no model benchmark numbers, no logos, no watermark. Preserve all stated labels exactly and avoid any extra text.

Keep 'Update weights' readable next to this corrected path. Remove the old dashed stem originating at the reward box completely. Do not add or delete any other diagram elements.
